_about: Every picture in art/ that no spread of any edition loads is listed under parked with a reason, so nothing is kept by accident and nothing vanishes by accident. node scripts/check-story-art.mjs examples/story --park --reason "..." writes this list; node scripts/check-story-art.mjs examples/story checks it. A picture may leave the folder only with a note under removed, which node scripts/check-story-retired.mjs reads; a deleted story picture without one fails.

parked.reason: the first render of the kitchen table; the lamp was in the wrong place; kept for the before-and-after
its spread was retired from both editions on 2026-10-19 (it stalled the kitchen scene); the record and the picture stay
